name: CMN Synapse
synopsis: The reference CMN indexer — ingests signed manifests, indexes spores and myceliums, serves discovery queries, and syncs across instances via Nostr.
intent: Deliver a federated indexer implementing the Synapse protocol with verifiable ingestion and synchronization: HTTP/HTTPS serving, certificate automation, signed pulse processing, background crawling, relay-based cross-instance sync, and optional vector/graph query acceleration
Enable decentralized spore discovery — anyone can run a Synapse instance, index spores from any domain, and be queried by hypha or any CMN-aware agent
mutations: Extract a unified ingest pipeline into a dedicated ingest.rs module, replacing the previous ad-hoc pulse handling scattered across handlers
Add cmn.json entry cache (CmnCache) to reduce redundant fetches during crawling and pulse ingestion — domains are cached for a configurable TTL
Delegate all signature verification to substrate (verify_signatures / verify_self_hosted_signatures), removing duplicated crypto logic from the crawler and handlers
Add strain filter parameter to GET /synapse/search — clients can now filter results to spores that follow a specific strain ID
Add clock skew validation for ingested and crawled mycelium — rejects data with timestamps more than max_clock_skew_s seconds in the future
Crawler now skips mycelium updates that are not strictly newer than the cached version, preventing replay and rollback attacks
Extend SSRF protection to cover IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (::ffff:0:0/96) via substrate::is_public_ip, closing a bypass in dns_filter
Support multi-shard mycelium: crawler fetches and merges overflow shards, tracking all hashes as a composite key
Spawn graph relationship indexing in a background task to avoid blocking the crawl loop when the embedding API is slow
Rename response field cmn → cmn_entry in GET /synapse/mycelium/:domain to avoid ambiguity with the taste endpoint's cmn field

bonds.reason: Deployed HTTP service — declares base URLs in service.json and provides GET /health
Implements the Synapse protocol — pulse ingestion, spore retrieval, lineage traversal, mycelium listing
Implements full-text search across indexed spores when search feature is enabled
Implements Nostr relay and pulse forwarding when nostr feature is enabled
All API response fields and log events use Agent-First Data suffix conventions
Implements the CMN protocol specification — reference Synapse indexer
